question: Can a learned passage relevance bias correct long-context address selection without rewriting the arithmetic decoder?
training: Freeze every Qwen parameter and both existing adapters. Train a small native MLX multi-vector encoder on 320 fresh synthetic ledgers or prose registers of 384-896 tokens with closely confusable three-word names. Supervise the distribution over fixed 12-token sliding windows using the gold value position only during training. Use shared frozen Qwen token embeddings, learned feature projection, adjacent-token features and learned query salience. All source windows before the last 64 prompt tokens are eligible. The inference API receives only token IDs and the decoder, never record boundaries, key strings, or gold answers.
architecture: Reweight full-history attention at attention sites in layers >=8, from the last input token through decoding. Add a finite positive bias to a contiguous passage selected by the learned scorer. Keep all KV positions, source tokens, prompt IDs and vocabulary logits in the normal model. Gain increases logarithmically above 2048 tokens. For inputs shorter than 1024 the model executes the original arithmetic path exactly. No text retrieval, external index, answer copying or extra prompt tokens.
calibration: After one training endpoint choose the fixed gain from 3,6,9 with highest correct completed turns on 12 separate 1024-token calibration items, ties to the lower gain. Require selected passage contains the gold token span on >=10/12 and >=8/12 correct with the chosen gain before measuring fresh longer prompts. No further tuning. Charge all calibration.
evaluation: Eight independent requests on fresh seeds: 2048 and 16384 token floors, target at 10% and 75%, a ledger or a prose rendering with held-out wording. Include near-miss keys. Same complete token streams, thinking template, full KV, first-turn greedy scoring and 96-token budget for trained system and untouched Base. Require >=7/8 correct, >=3/4 at 16K, both renderings successful there, >=2 net gains over Base and total generation seconds <=1.75x Base. Require identity of arithmetic backbone, all 32 archived short ability outputs reproduced, and V3 NLL within Base+0.03. Only a passing primary can advance to two fresh 131072-token counterfactual-value requests. Preserve failures and stop on limits.
